definitions.explanation: To wake a sleeping person by physically shaking them — typically the shoulder. Implies more vigor than simply calling their name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}り{起|お}こした。
examples.english: I shook my little brother awake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気付|きづ}かない→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{揺|ゆ}り{起|お}こした。
examples.english: My mother shook my father awake when he didn't notice the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}っている→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}り{起|お}こして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since the train has arrived at the last stop, the station staff are shaking the sleeping passengers awake.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{揺|ゆ}する→揺する：04598_yusuru⟧ (to shake) + ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to wake). Specifically refers to waking by physical shaking, distinguishing it from waking by voice or alarm.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧). The object is always a person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}り{起|お}こす: to shake by the shoulder to wake
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}り{起|お}こす: to shake a child awake
- ⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}り{起|お}こす: to shake a sleeping person awake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to wake up (someone) — general, by any means
- ⟦{揺|ゆ}する→揺する：04598_yusuru⟧: to shake — just the shaking action
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}めさせる→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧: to make wake up — broader, includes mental awakening (figurative use too)
